title: QueryDecomposition
description: Per-cell-type decomposition produced by the query-decomposer subagent (Layer B). Grounds one selected cell type and authors the search queries that citation-traversal consumes. The aspect names double as the report's sections (shared contract with synthesis). combined_query is the hybrid first pass; each aspects[].query is a focused follow-up used only where an aspect comes back thin or off-scope. seed maps to citation_traverse_input.seed_paper_id/seed_role; scope is orchestrator-side (evidence tagging + scope-targeted escalation), not part of the traversal input.

subject.description: Canonical name of the cell type being reported on (the CAS cell_label or its resolved full name).

aliases.description: Names the subject is known by — the union of CAS synonyms and paper-found names from resolve-name. Used to steer retrieval and gating toward the subject.

non_subject_terms.description: Confusable neighbours that are NOT the subject (e.g. sibling/precursor cell types from the CAS hierarchy). A sentence whose subject is one of these should not be treated as evidence about the subject.

scope.description: Biological context the report is restricted to — the query's contextual restriction unioned with the annotation's CAS composition. Drives evidence tagging and scope-targeted escalation. All keys optional.

aspects.description: One entry per report aspect, each with an authored focused query. The five names are fixed and correspond to the report's sections.

query.description: Focused retrieval query for this aspect (a retrieval seed, not a claim).

combined_query.description: All-aspect query for the hybrid first pass over the seed.

seed.description: The seed paper for citation traversal, from resolve-name's source_paper.

role.description: Provenance role stamped on hop-0 evidence.
